Nṛhari
See also Narasim3ha, Narahari an. Nṛsim3ha.

Nṛhari
son of Keśava: father of Kṛṣṇa; an. grandfather of Ānandavana (a. of C. on Rāmottaratāpanīyopaniṣad, Weber 360).

Nṛhari
father of Govinda (a. of Rasālaṅkāra, med. Bomb. Uni. 310).

Nṛhari
surnamed Paṇḍharapura. writer on dh.
--Cāturmāsyavihārakārikā. Bomb. Uni. 802.
--Cāturmāsyahautra. Bomb. Uni. 804.
--Prākṛtavihārakārikā. Bomb. Uni. 802.
--Prāsādapratiṣṭhā. Bomb. Uni. 1114.

Nṛhari
--Māsanirṇaya of Nibandharatnākara. dh.
See VVRI. 1149 (inc.); also D. Pingree, Census III. p. 207.

Nṛhari
of Hārītagotra.
--C. on Pādukāsahasra of Vedāntadeśika. MD. 10580.

Nṛhari(agnihotrī)
--Śāstradīpa. dh. Baroda 8132.
See P. V. Kane, HDS. I. p. 637a.

Nṛharibhaṭṭa(daivajña)
surnamed Saptarṣi.
--Maṇḍapakuṇḍamaṇḍana with C. Prakāśikā. IO. 3169.
--Vivāhacandrodaya. BBRAS. 330.
See D. Pingree, Census III. p. 207; also Narahari Bhaṭṭa, NCC. IX. p. 369b.

Nṛhariśakuna
